audit: Frozen Track A ensemble disagreement; diagnostic-only, no accuracy or selection claim.

metric_definitions.median_absolute_deviation: For each tract, median(abs(candidate score - median of the four candidate scores)); unscaled.
metric_definitions.p90_minus_p10_spread: For each tract, linear p90 minus linear p10 across the four frozen coverage_gap_score outputs.
metric_definitions.high_spread_flag: p90_minus_p10_spread >= 0.10; threshold fixed in the preregistration before this summary.

alignment.per_tract_order: official regional sample order; regions concatenated as listed
